name: On Holding
thesis: Premium Swiss performance sportswear compounder executing on the 'On Premium Playbook': (1) Structural channel mix shift toward Direct-to-Consumer (DTC sales +34.3% constant currency in Q2'26, expanding DTC share to 45.7% of net sales) driving gross margin to 65.4% (up 390 bps YoY); management raised full-year FY26 gross margin guidance to at least 65.0% and targeted >=65% through 2029 at the September 2026 Investor Day; (2) Strict full-price discipline—zero promotional discounting even during heavily promotional competitor environments; (3) Hyper-growth in Asia-Pacific (+54.7% constant currency in Q2'26, reaching CHF 170.5M) complemented by steady EMEA (+20.5% CC) and Americas (+13.0% CC) expansion; (4) Assortment expansion beyond running shoes: Apparel (+56.2% CC) and Accessories (+102.2% CC) compounding rapidly, with upcoming category entries into Football and Golf; (5) Proprietary manufacturing and performance innovation (LightSpray robotic automation, CloudTec Phase, Helion superfoams) validated by elite athlete partnerships (Zendaya, Roger Federer, Olympic champions); (6) High-quality cash generation: 19.8% Adjusted EBITDA margin in Q2'26 (targeting 22% by 2029) and an inaugural $1B share repurchase program authorized through 2029. Compelling risk/reward at ~13x forward EBITDA.
key_driver: DTC channel mix expansion, full-price gross margin preservation (>=65%), and APAC/Apparel category scaling

tier_1_kpis.name: Gross Profit Margin
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Compresses below 60.0% for 2 consecutive quarters (loss of full-price discipline / discounting)

tier_1_kpis.name: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Net Sales Mix
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: DTC growth decelerates below Wholesale growth for 2 consecutive quarters

tier_2_kpis.name: Apparel & Accessories Net Sales YoY (CC)
tier_2_kpis.current: Apparel +56.2% CC (CHF 54.2M); Accessories +102.2% CC (CHF 14.5M) in Q2'26
tier_2_kpis.break_condition: Apparel growth slows to footwear rate (<20%) indicating category extension failure

tier_2_kpis.name: Stock-Based Compensation / Revenue
tier_2_kpis.current: 1.4% (CHF 12.2M on CHF 850.3M net sales in Q2'26)

tier_3_kpis.name: Net Working Capital YoY Growth
tier_3_kpis.current: CHF 635.9M as of June 30, 2026 (+11.5% YoY vs +13.5% reported net sales growth)

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Widespread promotional discounting / markdowns damaging premium brand cachet and gross margin
Wholesale channel channel-stuffing or inventory buildup leading to write-downs
Failure of new sports category entries (Football, Golf) to gain athlete adoption
Key founder or elite talent departures (e.g. Roger Federer, Executive Founder Team)

break_rules.narrative: Gross margin falling below 60% indicates promotional discounting and pricing power loss.
Constant currency growth below 15% for 2 consecutive quarters indicates brand saturation.
